slides.title: RLS Career Overhaul v2.7.1 Hotfix
slides.subtitle: Hotfix · September 2026
slides.summary: Mod engines show up in maintenance again, and a pass of fixes for delivery, racing and career UI.

slides.title: Mod engines in maintenance
slides.summary: Engines with differently named part slots now appear correctly on the maintenance computer.
facts: Fallback visibility for non-standard mod engine slot names
Maintenance computer reads those engines the same way as stock packages

slides.title: And everything else
slides.lead: The smaller fixes that keep career running.

columns.heading: Delivery and travel
items: Delivery spawns no longer report success after a timeout or failed placement
Trailers no longer land in occupied parking spots
GPS and ground-marker routing is more stable

columns.heading: Driving and events
items: Pause gear guard no longer fights intentional Neutral or 1st at road speed
Freeroam drag HUD idle spam near the strip is gone
Racing AI no longer updates twice per frame; power request fallback works again

columns.heading: Career reliability
items: Full-garage purchase and put-away no longer error on checkout
Business, car-meet, economy and challenge helpers hardened against nil crashes
Temporary OBD Scanner phone app removed pending further work
